title: Growth config: RECOMMENDATION_POLICY
description: Thresholds of the rule-based growth recommendations (GRW-P3-E). Aggregates only; k never below 10. Reporting and proposals only: a recommendation changes nothing by itself. Added in 1.13.0; defaults equal the values that shipped in code. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

k.description: k-anonymity floor of every number a recommendation rests on. Never below 10 (ADR-007).

spendFloorMinor.description: A CAC below this spend (minor units) says nothing. Same floor as the channel performance report.

expiryDays.description: An unanswered proposal expires after this many days.

maxPerRun.description: Most proposals one nightly run may create.

maxShiftBp.description: Most a reallocation may suggest moving, in basis points of the weaker channel spend.

minRatioBp.description: Stronger channel must beat the weaker by this ratio in basis points (15000 = 1.5 times).

maxAiSummariesPerDay.description: AI-written summaries per day (0 = none). Aggregates only.
